network.tdhHistoric.provenance: Schedules 1.1 to 1.3 are as 6529.io published them on its TDH pages; 1.4 is the backend’s current rule file, which P26 cites line by line. Only 1.4 is checked: by the replay of the October 11, 2026 cycle, and on every day compared since October 14.
network.tdhHistoric.provenance.archive: Schedules 1.1 to 1.3: the historic boosts page’s source at commit 2d92c95 (October 9, 2025)
network.tdhHistoric.provenance.rules: Schedule 1.4: the backend’s rule file at d0c070c, the commit P26 cites
network.tdhHistoric.current.rules: Schedule 1.4 pays +0.05 for each complete season of seasons 1 to 20, except the current one; without the whole of Season 1, Memes 1 to 3 (Genesis) add +0.01 and Meme 4 (Nakamoto) +0.01. A full set pays every boostable season’s bonus at once, and each further full set a smaller extra bonus. Each Gradient adds +0.02, up to 5. The TDH v1.4 specification restates this schedule exactly.
